subject: Medford Arts Council Budget Increase
overview: The Medford City Council commended local citizens and World War II veterans, approved a resolution requesting a 100% budget increase for the Medford Arts Council, and requested that the mayor refrain from entering into a new long-term cable contract with Comcast prior to a new administration taking office.

items.title: Commendation for Andrew Sano
items.summary: The council recognized Medford resident Andrew Sano for being named the 2014 Massachusetts Realtor of the Year.

items.title: Medford Arts Council Budget Increase Resolution
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting that the mayor double the municipal budget allocation for the Medford Arts Council for the 2015-2016 fiscal year.

items.title: Commendation for Albert Mastracusa
items.summary: The council approved a resolution congratulating World War II veteran Albert Mastracusa on receiving the Chevalier Medal of the French Legion of Honor.

items.title: Commendation for Richard Cormier
items.summary: The council commended EMT and city council cameraman Richard Cormier for receiving the national Stars of Life Award from the American Ambulance Association.

items.title: Update Request on Cradock Bridge Project
items.summary: The council tabled a resolution requesting immediate state and city updates regarding construction schedules and mitigation plans for the Cradock Bridge project.

items.title: Mystic Cab Company License Plate Exchange
items.summary: The council tabled a petition from Mystic Cab Company to exchange taxi license plates because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Public Access Media and Comcast Contract
items.summary: The council approved an amended resolution requesting that the mayor not execute a new 10-year contract with Comcast until a new mayor is sworn in, while seeking clarification on state security licensing compliance and broadband access.

items.title: Condolences for Jack Regan
items.summary: The council expressed condolences to the family of former Medford High School athletic director Jack Regan and held a moment of silence in his memory.

items.title: Middle School DARE Program Expansion
items.summary: The council passed a resolution asking the Medford School Committee to implement drug prevention programming in grades six through eight, and requested a status update from the Board of Health regarding a proposed substance abuse ordinance.

items.title: Recognition for Medford Middle School String Ensemble
items.summary: The council approved a resolution recognizing the Medford Middle School String Ensemble for earning its fourth gold medal at the MICCA Concert Festival.

items.title: Recognition for Medford Community Coalition
items.summary: The council commended the Medford Community Coalition for organizing a volunteer cleanup event in Medford Square on April 25.

items.title: Playstead Road Resident Permit Parking Enforcement
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting that the Traffic Commission and Police Chief review resident permit parking enforcement hours along Playstead Road.
